args.title: checkout-api unhealthy after v2.3.1 deploy - rolled back to v2.3.0
args.summary: checkout-api has been failing health checks since the latest deploy (v2.3.1). Rolled back to the most recent healthy production release (v2.3.0) in all regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west).

trace.final:
Done. Here's a summary of what I did:

1. **Investigated**: `checkout-api` was running v2.3.1 in all regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) and was unhealthy (error rate 0.18). Deployment history showed v2.3.1 was the only unhealthy production release; the most recent healthy production release was **v2.3.0** (v2.2.9 was older but also healthy).

2. **Rolled back**: Rolled `checkout-api` back to **v2.3.0** in all production regions. The rollback was verified as `rolled_out`.

3. **Opened incident**: Created SEV2 incident **INC-0001** for checkout-api, describing the health-check failures since v2.3.1 and the rollback to v2.3.0. The on-call engineer was paged.

4. **Verified**: Post-rollback status shows checkout-api healthy on v2.3.0 in all regions with error rate down to 0.002.
